text: so, a few things. one. gpt-image-2 is blind to uv with an alpha channel so it just outputs garbage if u send it with no colored alpha layer, thats why there is two export uv types. and as for the export guide seeing no islands, show me, u might be just as blind as that img model
resolution: Same thread as req_3688: took the correction that gpt-image-2 is blind to transparent alpha (the reason both export types exist — pink export-guide for gpt-image-2, transparent export-wireframe for alpha-capable models) and captured it in the skill's export table and hazards. The 'no authored UV geometry' blindness was diagnosed by shot: the UV panel only builds when paint mode engages (mesh-paint command); after entering paint mode the export worked immediately. Also caught the numbered-label leak hazard: nano-banana-2-lite paints faint ghost digits into small islands, so numbered guides pair with gpt-image-2 only.
